svg.title: Chatbot sequence from a chat client
svg.desc: The chat client hands the question to the conversation, which asks a local intent classifier first, then runs the model's tool loop against the database, then the output checks, and updates its state.

text.tspan: [until a final answer, at most eight model calls]

svg.text: question, system prompt with state, tools, history
JSON result, recorded for the checks
cited ids and figures against recorded results
update state from the tool calls, keep the turn
